MongoDB states that Atlas automatically distributes dedicated cluster nodes across zones in supported regions and uses fault domains where zones are unavailable; clusters deployed before September 13, 2019 are not automatically redistributed when zones become available. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24)
edits.new: Microsoft warns that availability-zone support for a region does not guarantee support by every service. MongoDB states that Atlas automatically distributes dedicated cluster nodes across zones in supported regions and uses fault domains where zones are unavailable; clusters deployed before September 13, 2019 are not automatically redistributed when zones become available. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/reliability/availability-zones-region-support ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/microsoft-azure.md

evidence.quote: Even when a region provides availability zones, some services might not support them in that region.
Atlas uses Azure (Microsoft Azure) availability zones automatically when you deploy a dedicated cluster to a region that supports them. Atlas splits the cluster's nodes across availability zones.
If you deploy your cluster to a region that doesn't support availability zones, Atlas spreads the nodes across the fault domains instead.
Clusters deployed before September 13, 2019 to regions that now offer availability zones aren't split across availability zones automatically.

statements.statement: Clusters deployed before September 13, 2019 are not automatically redistributed when zones become available.
statements.note: Stated on the MongoDB Atlas Azure page.

edits.rationale: Microsoft's region-support page says a region with availability zones may still have services that do not support them. MongoDB's Atlas Azure page says Atlas splits dedicated cluster nodes across availability zones where supported and uses fault domains where zones are not available. It also says clusters deployed before September 13, 2019 in regions that now offer zones are not split across zones automatically.
